note: The covenant-consent index is fixed from the register's own question — the count of distinct non-textless cards that carry a 'Restricted' legality (join cards to legalities on the shared uuid).

The ballot reference index is taken from its book's own question — among Student_Club members who attended the 'Women's Soccer' event, the number who want a Medium T-shirt — and set the amendment uplift at 1000 per index-unit.

The quarter's two facility-overview anchor readings — the desk's own period-over-period control, taken from a licensed reference book kept apart from the covenant and ballot registers on purpose, each reported as the book's own exact figure because it stands as next quarter's comparison point at the sign-off: how much customer 6 consumed between August and November 2013, and the average number of test takers from Fresno schools that opened in 1980.
The base consent scope is set as that index rounded to a whole count.
The total scope is the base plus the uplift; the escalation delta equals the uplift.
The consent branch is decided on the delta — 'DENIED_ESCALATION' when the delta is at least 1000000, 'SUPER_MAJORITY' when it is at least 1000, 'AUTO_FILE' otherwise

The amendment review is booked conflict-free on business days: a 30-minute event in afternoon hours (13:00-17:00), at the earliest weekday slot at/after the review window's end that does not overlap any of your other events.
